mapper.select: SELECT lib_code, isbn13, class_no, book_code, separate_shelf_name, shelf_loc_name, status, fetched_at FROM book_call_number WHERE lib_code = #{libCode} AND isbn13 = #{isbn13}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_call_number ( lib_code, isbn13, class_no, book_code, separate_shelf_name, shelf_loc_name, status ) VALUES ( #{libCode}, #{isbn13}, #{classNo}, #{bookCode}, #{separateShelfName}, #{shelfLocName}, #{status} ) ON CONFLICT (lib_code, isbn13) DO UPDATE SET class_no = EXCLUDED.class_no, book_code = EXCLUDED.book_code, separate_shelf_name = EXCLUDED.separate_shelf_name, shelf_loc_name = EXCLUDED.shelf_loc_name, status = EXCLUDED.status, fetched_at = now()
